															Medical Fitness Criteria

															Candidates must be in good health and free from the following conditions to be eligible for appointment:

															
																
																General Health: No diseases of the bones or joints, no physical disabilities, and no history of mental illness or seizures.
																
																
																Vision & Hearing: Male candidates must have 6/6 vision in each eye (with or without glasses). Candidates must not have color blindness or night blindness. Hearing ability must be normal.
																
																
																Internal & Skin Health: Normal blood pressure and no functional or organic heart/blood vessel diseases. Candidates must be free from HIV, Hydrocele, Varicocele, or Piles. Routine ECG and EEG must be within normal limits.

															Medical Fitness Criteria

															Candidates must be in good health and free from the following conditions to be eligible for appointment:

															
																
																General Health: No diseases of the bones or joints, no physical disabilities, and no history of mental illness or seizures.
																
																
																Vision & Hearing: Male candidates must have 6/6 vision in each eye (with or without glasses). Candidates must not have color blindness or night blindness. Hearing ability must be normal.
																
																
																Internal & Skin Health: Normal blood pressure and no functional or organic heart/blood vessel diseases. Candidates must be free from HIV, Hydrocele, Varicocele, or Piles. Routine ECG and EEG must be within normal limits.
																
																
																Other Conditions: Candidates must not have a "Claw Hand". Any skin disease likely to cause disability or disfigurement will result in disqualification

																General Health: No diseases of the bones or joints, no physical disabilities, and no history of mental illness or seizures.

															Medical Fitness Criteria

															Candidates must be in good health and free from the following conditions to be eligible for appointment:

															
																
																General Health: No diseases of the bones or joints, no physical disabilities, and no history of mental illness or seizures.
																
																
																Vision & Hearing: Male candidates must have 6/6 vision in each eye (with or without glasses). Candidates must not have color blindness or night blindness. Hearing ability must be normal.
																
																
																Internal & Skin Health: Normal blood pressure and no functional or organic heart/blood vessel diseases. Candidates must be free from HIV, Hydrocele, Varicocele, or Piles. Routine ECG and EEG must be within normal limits.

																General Health: No diseases of the bones or joints, no physical disabilities, and no history of mental illness or seizures.

															Medical Fitness Criteria

															Candidates must be in good health and free from the following conditions to be eligible for appointment:

															
																
																General Health: No diseases of the bones or joints, no physical disabilities, and no history of mental illness or seizures.
																
																
																Vision & Hearing: Male candidates must have 6/6 vision in each eye (with or without glasses). Candidates must not have color blindness or night blindness. Hearing ability must be normal.
																
																
																Internal & Skin Health: Normal blood pressure and no functional or organic heart/blood vessel diseases. Candidates must be free from HIV, Hydrocele, Varicocele, or Piles. Routine ECG and EEG must be within normal limits.

															Medical Fitness Criteria

															Candidates must be in good health and free from the following conditions to be eligible for appointment:

															
																
																General Health: No diseases of the bones or joints, no physical disabilities, and no history of mental illness or seizures.
																
																
																Vision & Hearing: Male candidates must have 6/6 vision in each eye (with or without glasses). Candidates must not have color blindness or night blindness. Hearing ability must be normal.
																
																
																Internal & Skin Health: Normal blood pressure and no functional or organic heart/blood vessel diseases. Candidates must be free from HIV, Hydrocele, Varicocele, or Piles. Routine ECG and EEG must be within normal limits.
																
																
																Other Conditions: Candidates must not have a "Claw Hand". Any skin disease likely to cause disability or disfigurement will result in disqualification
